articles.title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity
articles.snippet: Vault12 raised $17.45 million selling VGT in 2018 and says it met or dropped every promise, yet the token has never traded on a centralized exchange.

articles.title: Dogecoin wallet, app teams unite in push to give DOGE more everyday uses
articles.snippet: Dogecoin Labs will combine MyDoge, DogeOS and merchant payment tools as developers try to turn coin holders into customers for applications and businesses.

articles.title: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
articles.snippet: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

articles.title: Zcash developers confirm November date for upgrade that triples payment speed
articles.snippet: The NU7 upgrade will cut the time between Zcash blocks to 25 seconds from 75 seconds. The chosen block height still has to be merged into the spec and shipped in node software.
